bersten.et:
From Middle High German brësten, from Old High German brëstan, from Proto-West Germanic *brestan, from Proto-Germanic *brestaną.
The modern form is from Middle Low German with metathesis of -r- from Old Saxon brestan (compare Bernstein, Born). Cognate with Dut…

s: disgusting, awful, nasty (evoking a very strong negative reaction)
Uih! Da sind ja berstige Schreib-/Tippfehler drin...
Ooh! That's some nasty typos in there...
Das Öl hat sich in dickes,teerartiges Fett verwandelt.Richtig berstig!
The oil has turned into a thick,tar-like grease.Disgusting as hell!
Bersenbrück (a town in western Lower Saxony, Germany)
